name: inspira-multi-step-loader
blurb: Full-screen multi-step loader with progress animation and step indicators.
description: A full-screen overlay loader that displays a sequence of steps with animations, icons for progress status (pending, loading, completed), and optional afterText labels.
use_when: Showing sequential progress through a multi-step process like installation, deployment, or data processing.
avoid_when: For simple loading spinners or when a modal isn't appropriate.
a11y: Displays step text and icons, close button is visible when not preventClose. Steps are semantic text.
